summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented across rich/highlighter.py (JSONHighlighter), rich/default_styles.py (six json.* keys), new rich/json.py (JSON renderable plus python -m rich.json entry), rich/console.py (Console.print_json), and rich/__init__.py (package-level print_json). Tests added: test_print_json in tests/test_console.py and test_rich_print_json in tests/test_rich_print.py. Docs added: a "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst, a new docs/source/reference/json.rst in the reference toctree, and a changelog entry under Unreleased. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. The new tests' expected ANSI strings were derived by reading the code, so they still need a test run. I read the spec's "overflow to none" as Python None.
